name: Shou Lei Shengcun De
source:
Inspired by [url=https://vndb.org/v33399]Oskemo Island no Himitsu[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/v34943]Disguise[/url], the theme of "The Habiata of Beast" is "obscenity yet rationality" and "identity mystery".

This homoerotic furry game tells a story about a stowaway who living in a city-state called "City of Infinite Beasts". But his identity and childhood experience doomed him to an extraordinary and challenging life...

Humankind must depends on the beasts if they want to continue to survive (Is that really the truth?)

[Edited from [url=https://promethues.itch.io/beast-habitat]Itch.io[/url]]
